lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice softer polite requests with skulle du kunna and skulle det vara möjligt att.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Contacting a clinic, service desk, or neighbor to ask for a small adjustment.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Making a polite request without sounding too direct.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss how to ask politely to move an appointment or change a small service arrangement.

main_focus.name: soft polite requests with skulle
main_focus.description: Use fixed polite request frames with skulle to soften a practical request.
model_examples: Skulle du kunna boka om tiden?
Skulle det vara möjligt att komma lite senare?
main_focus.desired_presence: Use polite request frames naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: simple reason phrase with för att
avoid_grammar: hypothetical skulle beyond polite request chunks

useful_chunks: Skulle det vara möjligt att boka om?
Jag undrar om det finns en senare tid.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use the polite chunks as reusable frames for adult service interactions.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person needs to change an appointment or arrangement.
dialogue_shape.middle: They practice or use a polite request, explain the simple reason, and discuss an alternative time.
dialogue_shape.ending: They settle on the wording or the new time.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat the polite request frames without turning them into a grammar lecture

focus: what arrangement needs to be changed
why a softer request is useful
which alternative time or wording is preferred

sentence_focus: one polite request with skulle du kunna
one polite request with skulle det vara möjligt att
one sentence explaining that a time does not fit
one sentence asking about a later time
